mstts:express-as.prosody: Imagine a time when companies spoke to the masses—one big message, hoping someone would listen. But now, things have changed in the most fascinating way. We find ourselves in an era where treating each person as truly unique isn't just possible—it's absolutely essential. That’s what makes the story behind Segment of One, written by Michael Grigsby, so exciting. Together, we're about to explore how technology, data, and our own expectations as consumers have come together to completely reshape the way businesses connect with us. We'll follow the journey from old-school, blanket marketing to a much more personal approach—one where every choice, every preference, and every little detail matters. Along the way, we’ll discover how the lines between companies and their customers have started to blur, making every interaction a real opportunity to build something meaningful. We’ll dive into the strategies and mindsets that help organizations not just keep up, but truly thrive in this new world—where delivering a personal touch isn’t just “nice to have”, it’s the key to delighting people like you and me. So, let’s set off on this journey through Segment of One, and see how putting individuality at the heart of every business decision is changing the game for all of us.
